description: This file defines a generic immutable wrapper struct and an extension method to convert objects into immutable wrappers, used within the Orleans distributed application framework to optimize message passing.

classes.name: Immutable<T>
classes.description: A readonly struct that wraps a value of type T to indicate immutability and optimize serialization in Orleans.

classes.name: ImmutableExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing an extension method to convert any object into an Immutable wrapper.

methods.name: Immutable(T value)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps the provided value in an Immutable struct.

methods.name: AsImmutable<T>(this T value)
methods.description: Extension method that returns the object wrapped in an Immutable struct.
